reliability_finding.issue: The staging E2E formerly embedded a numeric timestamp/run id in the citizen text. The conservative phone-number PII detector could classify that synthetic text as contact data and route the test to privacy_hold.
reliability_finding.fix: The citizen-text fixture is now stable and PII-neutral; run identifiers remain outside the PII-scanned citizen text.
reliability_finding.verification: A fresh neutral synthetic submission progressed received -> structured -> cluster_review -> precheck and received the audited STANDARD/standard_review path.

safety.note: Deletion remains an auditable review request. Operator/legal resolution is a separate future step.
